text:
marta_cs: FYI — EmberLane renewal is flagged. Procurement bounced the e-sign because card on file needs verification and legal wants term changed to 12m from 9m. I uploaded the addendum draft: https://docs.redwood/emberlane/addendum-v2 (needs review).

sam_ae: Ok — do we have updated ARR/price? I thought they were staying at current commit but adding seats.

marta_cs: Current renewal line: $48,000/yr for 10 seats. Sales requested +3 seats, pro rata for remaining month of current term. Proposed new term = 12 months, same unit price.

liam_fin: Need explicit invoice language for procurement. Suggest:```Invoice: 12-mo commitment, $4,000 per seat/yr, seats: 13 effective 2026-04-01, prorated amount for 2026-03 of $1,333.33 due on signature.```Procurement will want PO reference and CC verification.

olivia_csm: Onboarding health is green — they've completed SSO + first-week training, CSAT 4.6. Recommend keeping renewal cadence but confirm enablement checklist complete before term starts.

noah_salesops: @marta_cs can you get procurement contact and card verification? I can spin up a clean addendum that includes a PO field and CC verification clause. Also propose adding fallback: automatic renewal unless 60 days notice.

marta_cs: Procurement contact: rachel@emberlane.com. Card on file ends 03/24 needs CVV reauth. I've pinged Rachel asking for CC confirmation and PO number.

escalation-bot: Reminder: Renewal for EmberLane is within 14 days. SLA: 72h to resolve procurement blockers for on-time renewal.

sam_ae: Quick check — if we switch to 12mo and add seats, do we need legal approval for pricing? last I heard pricing bands require AM sign-off at >15% delta. This is ~0% delta for unit price but +3 seats only.

liam_fin: No pricing approval needed for seat count change under 20% threshold. Finance will only need PO + invoice line and CC verification for auto-charge.

olivia_csm: I'll add enablement handoff note to the addendum: kickoff scheduled 2026-04-05, success KPIs, and contact list. Keeps everyone aligned.

noah_salesops: I drafted an addendum snippet with PO/CC clause. Pasting here for review:
```
Addendum: EmberLane
- Term: 12 months starting 2026-04-01
- Seats: 13 (3 added)
- Price: $4,000/seat/yr
- Proration: $1,333.33 for 1 month pro rata
- Payment: Customer to provide PO within 5 business days; if PO not provided, charge card on file after CC reauth.
```

marta_cs: This looks good. Next actions: (1) @rachel/emberlane provide PO and CC auth, (2) @liam_fin prepare invoice with PO field, (3) @olivia_csm confirm kickoff doc attached. I can hold Docusign once PO arrives.

sam_ae: :thumbsup: I'll stand by to sign off if any price wording needs tweak.

liam_fin: I'll have invoice draft ready by EOD. Please confirm PO number in thread when available.

marta_cs: Rachel replied: "Confirming PO will be with our procurement team by EOD tomorrow. CVV reauth sent to payments@redwood.com" :eyes:

noah_salesops: Great — once PO comes in I'll drop final addendum into Docusign and assign to EmberLane legal for signature.

olivia_csm: Adding final checklist: onboarding tasks passed, success plan attached, training scheduled. Marking as "ready for signature" once PO and CC reauth confirmed.

marta_cs: Thanks team — looping back in this thread with PO/DOX when I have them. :white_check_mark:
